{{Quote|And here I thought you were a cautious man, Captain.''"<br />"''One day I'd like to be. For now, I want a word with that tac. In person.|ap-Orwien and Rex|<ref name="Speaking Silently">{{InsiderCite|139|Speaking Silently}}</ref>}}
A '''battle''' took place on [[Ereesus]] between the [[Ereesus Planetary Security Forces]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. A [[Squad/Legends|squad]] led by [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Palola]] was captured. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], who went by the name "Rex," led a team to recover them, acting on [[Kinetic communication|secret signals]] understood only by [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdians]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] freed the captives and took the [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Ereesus)|tactical droid's]] head.

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Ereesus appears in ''[[Speaking Silently]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and released in [[January]] [[2013]]'s [[Star Wars Insider 139|''Star Wars Insider'' 139]].
